findings.F1: The tested idea's rise was not graded inside its profile. Over the choppy calm cases on the 7-day grid, the next 7-day excess return by quintile of the scaled weekly rise was -0.9 %, -0.5 %, -1.8 %, -5.0 % (t -2.28) and +6.7 % (t 2.28), with 18 to 29 cases each. The slope over all signs had a day-clustered t of 1.03 (124 cases, 63 days). The step-5 size was -0.36 % per case (t -0.62), so the top quintile alone carries any effect, and its neighbour quintile shows the opposite.
findings.F2: Profit came from the coin's drift, not from timing. The total move per case was +0.60 % against a 0.19 % trade cost, but the unusual move was -0.36 %. The book's mean daily return was below holding's in 9 of the 12 shown windows, for example w11 at 0.00 bp against 125.62 bp and w16 at -3.54 bp against 45.37 bp.
findings.F3: The strongest pattern seen was choppy agitated short-term continuation, and it does not hold up. On the 3-day grid, the scaled 3-day return predicted the next 3-day excess return with an OLS t of 5.05, but only 2.05 with day clustering (70 cases, 54 days). It came from one year: the slope's t was 3.36 in 2020 (16 cases) against 0.53 in 2018 and 1.17 in 2019. It also sits in one tail: the lowest quartile averaged -9.95 % (18 cases) and the other three -2.4 % to +0.7 %. That is a falls-continue effect, brief 058's own theme, not a new situation.
findings.F4: In falling calm markets, the scaled weekly return's slope on the next 7-day excess return had a clustered t of 1.77 (153 cases, 56 days), and 2.22 for rises alone (53 cases). It changed sign across years: t 2.17 in 2018, -1.24 in 2019, 0.97 in 2021.
findings.F5: In falling agitated markets, weekly moves reversed, with a clustered t of -1.79 (88 cases, 30 days). By year the t was -2.79 in 2020 and -1.27 in 2018. The profile map already holds this with 12 long falling agitated rebound strategies.
findings.F6: In a rising market, Thursdays and Fridays were followed by +1.02 % next-day excess (t 2.34 clustered, 117 days). This is the map's held idea 045-01 (rising market late week gain).
findings.F7: Weekday effects did not stand out overall. No weekday's next-day excess reached a clustered |t| of 1.6 (from -1.29 for Wednesday to +1.52 for Friday). Wednesday's -1.60 % in 2019 (t -3.29) was one year among four.

no_ideas: Over about 30 angles (profiles × horizons × years × weekdays × quintiles), the only patterns near a clustered t of 2 are noise around the tested idea (F1), single-year or single-tail effects (F3, F4), or effects the map already holds (F5, F6), so none stands out enough to be a finding worth testing.
